identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of AK104 Plus Axitinib in Advanced/Metastatic Special Pathological Subtypes of Renal Cell Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of First-Line Cadonilimab Plus Axitinib in Patients With Advanced Special Pathological Type Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Prospective, Multi-center, Phase Ib/II Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This is a Phase Ib/II, open-label, single arm trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of AK104 in combination with axitinib as a first-line treatment for advanced/metastatic special pathological subtypes of renal cell carcinoma (ssRCC). Subjects will receive AK104 plus axitinib until disease progression, development of unacceptable toxic effects, death, a decision by the physician or patient to withdraw from the trial.

Primary objective:

Phase Ib: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of different doses of cadonilimab combined with axitinib as first-line therapy in subjects with advanced RCC with special pathological types to determine the recommended phase II dose (RP2D).

Phase II: To evaluate the objective response rate (ORR) of cadonilumab combined with axitinib as first-line therapy in subjects with advanced RCC with special pathological types according to the RECIST 1.1 criteria.

conditions: Non Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma

armGroups.label: Combination treatment group
armGroups.description: Subjects in this group will receive AK104 (RP2D, administered intravenously) plus Axitinib 5 mg bid, administered orally.

interventions.name: AK104
interventions.description: Anti-PD-1/CTLA-4 bi-specific antibody drug; Phase 1b: 10mg/kg or 15mg/kg; Phase 2: RP2D intravenously (IV)

interventions.name: Axitinib
interventions.description: An oral, small molecule, TKI selective for VEGFRs; 5mg bid orally

primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs) according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) version 5.0., dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) during the first treatment cycle, clinically significant abnormal laboratory tests, vital signs, and electrocardiogram (ECG); maximum tolerated dose (MTD), or the maximum administered dose (MAD) when MTD is not reached, as well as the recommended Phase II dose (RP2D).
ORR assessed by the investigator according to RECIST 1.1 criteria. objective response = complete response (CR) + partial response (PR).

secondaryOutcomes.description:
ORR, disease control rate (DCR), duration of response (DOR), progression-free survival (PFS), and overall survival (OS) assessed by the investigator according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.

DCR: The proportion of participants achieving CR, PR, or stable disease (SD); DOR: Time from the first occurrence of treatment response (CR or PR) to disease progression or death, whichever occurs first; PFS: Time from the first dose of the treatment drug to disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first; OS: Time from the first dose of treatment drug to death due to any cause.
Incidence and severity of AEs, clinically significant abnormal laboratory tests, vital signs, and ECG abnormalities.

Evaluate life quality using FKSI-19 and EQ-5D-5L
Evaluate pain using visual analogue scale (VAS)

otherOutcomes.measure: Phase Ib: To evaluate the pharmacokinetics of cadolinimab
otherOutcomes.description: serum drug concentration at different time points after administration for each subject, maximum concentration (Cmax), area under the plasma concentration-time curve (AUC), clearance (CL), and half-life (t1/2).
